messages:
maria_g: Heads-up — starting bring-up for a new candidate set for stella-70B: baseline fp16 + candidates awq-int8, gptq-4bit, fp8-mixed. Goal is to validate accuracy deltas and define cross-env rollout (hosted / dedicated / private).

maria_g: Primary evals: LRA-dialog-1k, instruction-qa, and our production prompt bank (500 samples). Acceptance: <=0.8% avg EM degradation vs fp16 across bank and no more than 1.5% on any slice.

devon_k: I ran quick perf on a315 (A100) for awq-int8 — p95 token latency looks good but memory spike on long convo prefixes. Need KV cache profiling.

sasha: Can we autotune microbatch/kv cache for hosted? Last time AWQ microbatching gave 18% cost savings but introduced occasional 200ms tail spikes.

maria_g: Yes — plan is: (1) smoke tests in hosted canary (1% traffic), (2) scale to dedicated dry-run (10% internal), (3) private onboarding via customer mirror. Canary gating will be accuracy-first, then latency + cost.

rik_o: Proposal for gating thresholds:
- accuracy: avg delta <= 0.8% and per-slice <= 1.5%
- p95 latency: <= baseline_p95 + 120ms for hosted, <= +80ms dedicated, <= +100ms private
- cost/token: <= +20% hosted, <= +12% dedicated
- error rate: 5xx <= baseline*1.2

maria_g: Also add quality safety checks: semantic drift detector and KL-divergence on logits for a small holdout. If either flags, rollback immediately.

devon_k: Can someone share the rollout config snippet? I'll wire up the traffic router.

sasha: Putting a draft here: 
```yaml
rollout:
  name: stella70b-quant-experiment-2026-03
  phases:
    - name: hosted-canary
      env: hosted
      weight: 0.01
      duration: 24h
      checks:
        accuracy: {threshold_pct: 0.8}
        latency: {p95_delta_ms: 120}
        fallback: on_failure: route_to: stella70b-fp16-hosted
    - name: dedicated-dryrun
      env: dedicated
      weight: 0.1
      duration: 48h
      checks: ...
    - name: private-mirror
      env: private
      weight: 0.0
      notes: manual verification
```

rik_o: Nice. Add a forced sample capture for any request with top_token_prob < 0.02 so we can triage low-confidence outputs.

quant-ci-bot: CI job quant-smoke-stella70b started — baseline metrics will be published to #ml-metrics in ~90m. :robot_face:

maria_g: For fallback policy, prefer same-arch higher-precision variant in same env (awq-hosted -> fp16-hosted). If capacity constrained, global fallback to nearest-region dedicated with traffic split 80/20.

devon_k: One operational nuance: private deployments may not have fp16 due to customer infra. For private, fallback should be configured per-customer: either different quant profile or revert to dedciated routing. We'll add a per-customer policy tag.

sasha: Also, for AWQ we should enable rolling KV cache warmup so cold-starts don't spike latency. Simple approach: route 5% of warmup-only traffic to build KV caches before canary.

maria_g: Agree. Action items: @devon_k wire router + warmup traffic; @sasha add capture hooks and semantic drift gating; @rik_o write per-customer private fallback template; I'll run the eval bank and post summary in ~3h.

devon_k: On it. I'll also add monitoring alerts for token-cost-per-minute.

rik_o: Will prototype private fallback template and post before EOD.

quant-ci-bot: quant-smoke-stella70b finished: preliminary numbers: awq-int8 avg EM delta 0.6%, p95 +95ms hosted, cost -14% hosted. Full report at https://internal.redwood/ml/metrics/2129987654.

maria_g: Great — patching rollout with those numbers. We'll keep gated canary open until semantic drift check passes. :thumbsup:
